description: Verified at develop 29380ce9e. Two coupled loose ends left by the one-engine program. FIRST: one-engine-core-run-service is state=done but its rung 4 ('! grep -rn l_shipdate|ss_sold_date_sk benchbox/cli/') still fails on benchbox/cli/commands/convert.py:166 and :170. Those two hits are '--partition l_shipdate' usage examples in a command docstring -- prose describing a user-supplied flag value, not a presort default -- so the rung greps prose it cannot distinguish from code. This was filed as deferral #699 during the program and dismissed without narrowing the rung, so the item carries a permanently-red gate. The other four keystone rungs pass (service exists and CLI consumes it, lint-imports 3 contracts kept, characterization suite green, full fast lane 27775 passed). SECOND, and the reason the first survived: 'todo verify <id>' reports last_run=null and last_result=null for nearly every rung on these items, so the ladders were never executed at all. Sampled one-engine items: core-run-service 5/5 rungs never run, mcp-run-service-adoption 4/4, sink-mcp-logic 3/3, parity-ledger 2/2, unify-statistics 0/3. unify-statistics is the control -- its rungs were run and recorded, so the recording path works and simply was not used elsewhere. The completion gate added later (todo complete --override-verification) only binds completions from that point forward, so it does not retroactively cover items already marked done.
